answer: Because the counters live in the meadow ledger, a burst across neighbours is visible at replay instead of hidden. An operator running many aliases therefore burns for many distinct network origins and accepts the latency of spreading them thin, while each origin still has to clear the quill quota and the signal admission check. Submission rate is limited to 7 per autonomous system per minute, so a datacentre cannot pull quota for a whole army of identities from one uplink. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
